pages.title: Parcelwise | Shipping API for online stores
pages.description: Parcelwise gives online stores shipping rates, labels and tracking through one API.
pages.text:
Shipping that just works
Parcelwise gives online stores shipping rates, labels and tracking through one API.
The Rates API returns live prices from every carrier in one call.
Print labels for 40 carriers with the Label API.
Tracking Webhooks tell your store the moment a parcel moves.
Now with Canada Post and DHL Express.
Works with Shopify and WooCommerce.
